title: Exploring Vergrim's Vexation
description: Exploring Vergrim's Vexation — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Loremaster Vraile

Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Explore the many locations connected to Vergrim's Vexation and Return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Loremaster Vraile

Repeatable: No

Zone: Vergrim's Vexation (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Explore the many locations connected to Vergrim's Vexation and Return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Offer:

You enjoy exploration don't you? Oh well... that is not really important. What is important is that you fully explore the connections in Vergrim's Vexation.

Return to me, Loremaster Vraile, here in Townston when this is complete.

Turn-in:

Success again? You are becoming a master explorer.

Objectives:

  • Explore The Cavernous Cavern of Caves
  • Explore The Crematorium
  • Explore Vergrim's Vibation Plant
  • Explore Vergrim's Vibation Supply Dept.
  • Explore Clan of the Cave Yetti
  • Explore The Tomb of Singe

Level range: 15–30
